svg.title: 37. Kneeling front thigh and hip stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Kneel on one padded knee and put the other foot in front. Hold the back ankle, or use a strap, and draw the heel towards your buttock. Tuck your pelvis slightly while you keep the back thigh behind your hip.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://ie.physitrack.com/home-exercise-video/kneeling-quad-stretch
